# gl-transitions — credits and licences

Vendored from https://github.com/gl-transitions/gl-transitions on 2026-11-07.
Nothing here is fetched at runtime; the files are served from novaclip.org.

These licences require attribution. This file is that attribution, it ships
with the code, and the site links to it. Dropping it to save a request would
be a licence breach rather than an optimisation.

## Summary

| Licence | Transitions |
|---|---|
| MIT | 198 |
| BSD 3 Clause | 1 |
| BSD 2 Clause | 1 |

The repository's root MIT licence is reproduced in `LICENSE` beside this file.
